about.title: About
about.description: AfriPay Pro lets merchants collect their AfriPay sales, manage transfers, and track their daily activity.
about.shareMessage: Check out AfriPay Pro, the app that lets merchants collect their AfriPay sales, manage transfers, and track their daily activity! 🚀

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms of use govern the use of the AfriPay Pro app by merchant accounts. This document is provided for informational purposes as part of this project and should be reviewed by legal counsel before any production use.

sections.title: 1. Purpose
sections.body: AfriPay Pro is an app for merchants that lets them collect AfriPay payments, make transfers (Mobile Money or AfriPay account), and track their account activity.

sections.title: 2. Acceptance of terms
sections.body: By creating a merchant account or using the app, you fully accept these terms of use.

sections.title: 3. KYB validation
sections.body: Collecting payments requires your KYB file (ID document, RCCM and NCC for businesses, proof of address and activity) to be approved by our teams beforehand.

sections.title: 4. Account security
sections.body: You are responsible for keeping your PIN code and login credentials confidential. Report any suspicious activity immediately.

sections.title: 5. Collections and transfers
sections.body: Collections are credited to your AfriPay wallet after the customer is verified. Outgoing transfers (Mobile Money or AfriPay account) may be subject to fees, which will be shown before you confirm.

sections.title: 6. Disputes and refunds
sections.body: Any dispute regarding a collection must be reported as soon as possible. AfriPay reserves the right to review and, where applicable, cancel a fraudulent transaction.

sections.title: 7. Account suspension and closure
sections.body: AfriPay may suspend or close a merchant account in case of fraud, breach of these terms, or to comply with a legal or regulatory obligation.

sections.title: 8. Limitation of liability
sections.body: AfriPay is not liable for service interruptions, third-party provider outages, or losses resulting from a merchant's negligence in protecting their credentials.

sections.title: 9. Changes to these terms
sections.body: These terms may be updated at any time. You will be notified of any significant change via the app.

sections.title: 10. Contact
sections.body: For any question about these terms, contact us at the address shown in the "About" section.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy describes how AfriPay collects, uses, and protects your merchant account data. This document is provided for informational purposes as part of this project and should be reviewed by legal counsel before any production use.

sections.title: 1. Data we collect
sections.body: We collect your business or activity information (company name, RCCM, NCC, address), your KYB documents (ID document, proof documents), as well as your collection and transfer history.

sections.title: 2. Purposes of processing
sections.body: This data is used to create and secure your merchant account, meet our regulatory obligations (KYB/AML), process your collections and transfers, and provide support.

sections.title: 3. Legal basis
sections.body: Processing is based on the performance of our contract with you and compliance with the legal and regulatory obligations applicable to payment activities.

sections.title: 4. Data retention
sections.body: Your data is kept for as long as your account is active, then for the period required by regulations applicable to KYB records and financial transactions.

sections.title: 5. Data sharing
sections.body: Your data may be shared with our payment partners (Wave, Orange Money, Moov Money, MTN MoMo) strictly to the extent necessary to process your operations, or with competent authorities where required by law. It is never sold to third parties.

sections.title: 6. Data security
sections.body: Your PIN code is stored encrypted, and access to your data is protected and logged.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
sections.body: You have the right to access, correct, and delete your data, within the limits of legal retention obligations. You can exercise these rights by contacting us at the address shown in the "About" section.

sections.title: 8. Changes to this policy
sections.body: This policy may be updated. You will be notified of any significant change via the app.

faq.q: When can I start collecting payments?
faq.a: As soon as your KYB file is approved by an AfriPay agent from the back office. Track the status in the 'Account validation' section.

faq.q: How does the payment scan work?
faq.a: The customer shows a QR code on their AfriPay app ("Pay" screen). You scan this code with the camera to collect the amount — it replaces real palm recognition in this version.
It's only required to confirm transfers (Mobile Money or AfriPay account) of 50,000 FCFA or more.
